input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance clause anywhere: searches for insurance, errors and omissions, general liability, workers' compensation and certificates return nothing, and the General Provisions (Sections 10.1–10.8) run from notices to headings with no coverage covenant. HDI hosts and maintains the Site on its own server (p0007) and has access to Company Content, user information and customer order data (p0048), so the rule expects vendor coverage and the absence sits in walk-away territory for a vendor that processes our data. We insert the shortest clause meeting the fallback level (E&O USD 1,000,000; cyber and privacy USD 2,000,000); the preferred CGL limits, workers' compensation and certificate-on-request mechanics are not pursued given the low severity and the affiliate-style nature of this arrangement.

proposal.summary: Insert a short insurance covenant (E&O USD 1M; cyber USD 2M) in Section 10 General Provisions.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance covenant even though HDI hosts the Site and handles our Content and customer order data. We have added a short provision at our fallback position (errors and omissions of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of USD 2,000,000); our preferred position also includes commercial general liability and higher limits if you prefer to align with your standard certificates.

ops.text: Insurance. HDI shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
